purpose: Teach: 同名/気配り/調査官/貸借/割当/局員/上半期/釈明

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同名の社員がいるから、フルネーム表記にしましょう
lines.en: We should use full names since we have staff with the same name.
lines.style: Crisp, organizational tone. Light tempo. Treating it as a practical item on the meeting agenda, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様には細かい気配りを徹底します
lines.en: Yes — I'll make sure we're meticulous with our VIP clients on every detail.
lines.style: Attentive and assured. Quick pickup on the directive. Steady, reliable rhythm. Slight nod of confirmation in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 税務調査官の対応はチームで行いましょう
lines.en: Let's handle the tax investigator's visit as a team effort.
lines.style: Clear directive. Measured pace, slight emphasis on 'team'. Not demanding — collaborative framing that sets the standard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。施設の貸借料金を交渉中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently negotiating the facility rental fees.
lines.style: Factual, progress-focused delivery. Calm confidence. Slight upward lift at the end — not a question, but checking that the update lands.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 週末勤務の割当を公平にしましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure weekend shifts are assigned fairly.
lines.style: Even-handed, measured directive. Slight warmth underneath — fairness as a value, not a rule. Calm, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。郵便局員さんとの連絡を密にします
lines.en: Understood. I'll keep our postal office contact regular and frequent.
lines.style: Committed, assured. Quick rhythm. The 'understood' is warm, not just obedient — shows alignment with the priority.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 上半期報告書を早めに仕上げましょう
lines.en: Let's get the first-half report finished ahead of schedule.
lines.style: Forward-momentum directive. Brisk but not rushed. Light emphasis on 'ahead' — setting an ambitious but achievable pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への釈明会議を設定しました
lines.en: Yes — I've scheduled the apology meeting with our VIP clients.
lines.style: Decisive, task-complete tone. Quick rhythm. Confident delivery — action already taken. Slight landing emphasis on 'scheduled'.
